bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 $73–76 支撑

read.en: AAOI fell 12.0% on Oct 22 to $68.07, trading between $66.30 and $73.15, a new October low. It is below the falling 5-day ($75.2), 10-day ($85.4), 30-day ($99.0) and 100-day ($121.1) averages and the rising 200-day ($113.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and is below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($104.40), and RSI is 31.
read.zh: AAOI 10月22日下跌 12.0%，收于 $68.07，盘中区间 $66.30–73.15，创 10 月新低。股价位于下行的 5 日（$75.2）、10 日（$85.4）、30 日（$99.0）和 100 日均线（$121.1）以及上行的 200 日均线（$113.0）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，且在零轴之下；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$104.40），RSI 为 31。

read.en: The drop broke the $76 (Jul 29 low) and $73 (Oct 20 low) supports, which now turn into resistance; the low stopped just above the $65.6 Feb 27 gap low. Resistance is $73–73.15, then $75.2–76 (5-day average, Jul 29 low) and $81.2 (Oct 21 high). Support is $65.6–66.3, then $60. A close above $76 would target $81.2; a close below $65.6 would open $60.
read.zh: 股价跌破 $76（7月29日低点）和 $73（10月20日低点）支撑，二者转为阻力；盘中低点止步于 2月27日跳空低点 $65.6 上方。阻力为 $73–73.15，其次 $75.2–76（5 日均线、7月29日低点）和 $81.2（10月21日高点）。支撑为 $65.6–66.3，其次 $60。若收盘站上 $76，下一目标看 $81.2；若收盘跌破 $65.6，将打开 $60。

r.en: Oct 20 low $73.05; Oct 22 high $73.15, now resistance
